groups: 🔥 Kill streaks
Kill monsters less than 7 s apart and they chain up. At 3, 6, 10, 16 and 25 in a row you get a banner and more XP and lira, up to [b]×3[/b]!
A small 🔥 counter above your weapon shows the streak, and its line shows how long you have for the next kill. [i]seri[/i] = streak.
Bug fixed: monsters pay their XP again.
💃 You
Your braids swing now! They fly out behind you when you run or ride, swing when you turn and bounce when you land.
A heavy hit ([b]RIGHT click[/b]) with empty hands is a big roundhouse kick now.
While you shoot, your body keeps leaning with the mouse.
The gear you wear shows on you: your glasses, hoop earrings, the nazar necklace, the gold chain, the bracelet, bags, roller skates and platform shoes.
🚲 Your bike
Bike gear shows on the bike: [b]Neon Lastik[/b] glowing tyres, the gold [b]Zil[/b] (bell), the chrome [b]Krom Zincir[/b] (chain) and the pink [b]Neon Far[/b] (lamp) that lights the road at night.
From level 15 your Diamond Back gets its pink neon underglow.
Bike speed bonuses add up the 7.2 way again.
🌊 The city moves
The beach club neon pulses, the ferry sails the river, the windmill turns, the gods' coins spin and the water bobs.
⚙️ Settings
New [b]YAZI BOYUTU · TEXT SIZE[/b] in the pause menu ([b]P[/b]): 80% up to 175% for calls, toasts, lessons, quizzes, the guide and the bag.
If the game runs slow on your Mac, it lowers the graphics by itself and tells you. Want it back? [b]P → GRAFİK[/b], or the new [b]🔭 VIEW[/b] button.
💡 Small stuff
Stuck in a quiz? [b]💡 İPUCU[/b] (hint): press [b]H[/b] or click it. 15₺, one per question.
Monster speech bubbles sit above their level tags now.
Lessons show in a smaller box, so you still see the city.
Closing the game is safe now, no more crash on quit.
Finding glasses (+1 🧠 INT) makes its little chuckle again.
❤ Your save is safe
Same save as 7.2. Bring it in once with [b]💾 SAVE & LOAD[/b] and everything is there: your level, words, weapons, gear, beads and quests.
Every key you know still does the same thing. The new moves got new keys of their own.
⚔️ Real fighting now
[b]F / click[/b] chains into a 3-hit combo. [b]RIGHT click[/b] is a heavy hit: hold it to charge, it breaks guards.
[b]Left Ctrl[/b] = dodge roll. Roll [i]through[/i] a hit and it can't touch you.
[b]Hold Z[/b] to block. Block right before a hit lands = [b]PARRY[/b]: the monster is stunned and wide open.
[b]Tab[/b] locks on to a monster (Tab again = the next one). The camera keeps you both in view.
Monsters wind up before they hit — watch for the flash and the sound, then roll or parry.
🏃 Moving with weight
A better jump: you can still jump a moment after running off an edge, and a jump pressed just before landing still happens.
Jump at a low wall and you grab the ledge and climb up by yourself.
[b]Shift[/b] sprint, rolls and heavy hits use the green [b]stamina[/b] bar. Skills use the blue [b]mana[/b] bar.
👹 A city that fights back
Monsters roam on their own now, and the night is [b]harder[/b]: more of them, tougher ones.
Minibosses walk around too. They hit hard and drop great stuff.
Every hit flashes, sparks and sounds like something. Every monster, every weapon, every step.
🎒 Loot, skills and the city
[b]1, 2, 3...[/b] (and [b]R[/b]) are your skills now, with cooldowns and the blue mana bar. New ones unlock as you level up.
Tap [b]Q[/b] for the next weapon, [b]hold Q[/b] for the weapon wheel. Guns shoot real bullets, and a right click fires a volley.
Monsters drop gear and coins, chests hide in the city, and the 50 nazar beads are out there again. [b]I[/b] = your bag, [b]J[/b] = quests.
The café, the jeweller, the tutors, Old Soul, the tavla tables and Kaan's monster service are all open again.
The trickster gods' shrines work any time now: 40₺ a flip, win 120₺ and their favour.
The sky follows your real clock, and a gold arrow over your head always points to the next goal.
🎬 The story is a story again
Kaan's calls are little movies: the phone rings, you say [i]Alo?[/i], you answer him in Turkish, then the mission title.
After some missions you'll see what's happening at [b]Hellspace Wealth[/b]. Karen is not happy.
A brand new game has its opening scene, and the end has credits. [b]E[/b] = next line, [b]ESC[/b] = skip.
Nothing can hurt you while a scene plays.
🧭 Menus and help
A title screen with [b]NEW GAME[/b] and [b]CONTINUE[/b]. New game asks first, and keeps a copy of your old save in Downloads.
[b]P[/b] pauses: music and sound volume, graphics, fullscreen, the guide, save & load.
[b]📘 GUIDE[/b] (in the pause menu) explains everything, with your own numbers.
First time you meet something new, a small card explains it once.
🙏 Thank you
Your 3D body is made by Kaan from your model sheet, starting from the free [b]PSX Secretary Character[/b] by [b]Vinrax[/b] (itch.io).
Everyone else in the city is built on two base models Kaan made, one for the boys and one for the girls.

l: [b]F[/b] or [b]left click[/b] = light hit. Keep pressing in rhythm and it chains into a [b]3-hit combo[/b].
[b]RIGHT click[/b] = heavy hit. Hold it to charge. Slower, but it hits much harder and breaks a guard.
Mix them: a light combo that ends in a heavy one is the strongest thing you can do.
[b]Left Ctrl[/b] = dodge roll in the way you're moving.
For a moment in the roll [b]nothing can hit you[/b]. Roll [i]through[/i] an attack, not away from it.
Rolling costs [b]stamina[/b] (the green bar). When it's empty you're winded for a second.
[b]Hold Z[/b] to block. You take much less damage, but it costs stamina.
Start the block [b]right before[/b] a hit lands and it's a [b]PARRY[/b]: no damage, and the monster is stunned.
Monsters flash and make a sound before they swing. That's your cue.
[b]Tab[/b] locks on to the nearest monster. [b]Tab[/b] again picks the next one.
Locked on, you always face it and the camera keeps you both in view. Its name, level and HP show over it.
[b]1, 2, 3...[/b] use your skills ([b]R[/b] is Dance Blast too). They cost [b]mana[/b], the blue bar.
Each one has a cooldown: the button at the bottom fills up again when it's ready.
More skills unlock as you level up. Right answers in quizzes give mana back.
Tap [b]Q[/b] (or the mouse wheel) for the next weapon.
[b]Hold Q[/b] for the weapon wheel: move the mouse to one and let go. The game slows down while it's open.
Weapons wear out as you swing them. The 🔧 number shows how many swings are left.
[b]I[/b] opens your bag: gear, snacks, beads and perk cards. [b]J[/b] opens the quests page.
[b]H[/b] eats your best snack straight away when you need HP fast.
Gear you wear makes you stronger. Better colours = better gear.
